 of 2019, 6252 of 2021 & 6455 of 2022
 Proceeding Sheet

Order 
Note 07.01.2025 RRR, J & MRK, J Heard Sri K. S. Murthy, learned Senior Counsel appearing for the displaced persons, on behalf of Sri Ponnada Sree Vyas, learned counsel for the petitioner and Smt. S.
Pranathi, learned Government Pleader in the office of the Learned Advocate General.
The dispute, which remains for consideration, before this Court, is whether the market value of the land is to be taken at Rs.13,00,000/- per acre or at Rs.7,00,000/- per acre.

It is the admitted case on both sides that the compensation payable @ Rs.13,00,000/- per acre, aggregating at Rs.6,16,69,000/-, has been deposited with this Court and a sum of Rs.2,96,61,000/- as compensation, if the market value is to be taken at Rs.7,00,000/- per acre has also been disbursed to the displaced persons.
The learned Government Pleader seeks time to obtain instructions as to how the market value of the land has been fixed at Rs.7,00,000/- by the respondent authorities.

Sri K. S. Murthy, learned Senior Counsel, while not disputing the above recorded facts, would further contend that the displaced persons are still entitled to interest, on the compensation amount, in accordance with Section 80 of the Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013 and the same has not been included,
in the aforesaid aggregated amount at Rs.6,16,69,000/-.
